description: 10 scènes (en anglais, comme celles écrites par Gemini pour le modèle d'image) pour mesurer le CLIP score texte-image.

scenes.scene: Two friends swimming in a calm turquoise sea under a striped beach umbrella
A young intern sitting at a desk with a laptop in a bright modern office
An old grandmother serving a large plate of fish couscous on a wooden table
A crowded metro carriage stopped in a dark tunnel
A wedding hall decorated with white jasmine flowers and people dancing
Hikers resting on a rocky mountain summit overlooking a wide green plain
A small ginger kitten climbing on long living room curtains
A family playing cards by candlelight on a rainy evening
Ancient Roman ruins with tall stone columns facing a blue sea
Hands shaping a clay bowl on a spinning pottery wheel
